course_outline_concepts: What SFT means across regimes: single-turn instruction, multi-turn chat, tool-call, reasoning, agentic
Loss masking per regime: system / user / assistant / tool-call / thought tokens
Chat-template design decisions and their downstream blast radius
Packing vs unpacking, NEFTune, prompt-masked vs full-sequence loss as tunable axes
What SFT can and cannot later be fixed by RL — the pre-determines framing
role_in_track: Opening chapter of the SFT track (ch-30..ch-36). Frames the five design axes that ch-31..ch-36 will each vary along.

sources.what_to_extract: Response-only vs full-sequence loss; label = -100 convention; multi-turn masking rule (mask all user turns + assistant 1..k-1, train only on a_k); Shi 2024 ablation result that response-only dominates except in tiny-dataset / strong-base regime; packed-sequence interaction with per-sub-sequence mask reset.
50-89% padding in raw SFT batches; SPFHP and NNLSHP bin-packing; cu_seqlens + position-ID reset contract; FlashAttention varlen API; mathematical equivalence when mask and position IDs are correct.

Uniform noise epsilon ~ U(-1,1) * alpha / sqrt(L*d); alpha in [5,15]; LLaMA-2-7B Alpaca 29.79 -> 64.69 AlpacaEval; saturates at large datasets (Tulu 3 939K finds neutral); stacks with packing / masking / FSDP.

SFTConfig(packing=True, train_on_response_only=True); Zephyr-7B-beta recipe (2e-5, cosine, 10% warmup, 1 epoch, global batch 128, FSDP FULL_SHARD); 'verify chat template by decoding a packed batch' lesson; NEFTune alpha=5 stacks cleanly.

Tulu-3 data-mix ratios (27/21/14/11/10/7/10); 8B/70B hyperparameters (5e-6 / 2e-6, 2 epochs, batch 128); NEFTune off at 939K (saturation); removing Persona-Math costs 15 pts GSM8K; removing safety: capability flat, WildJailbreak 98 -> 52.
939,344 prompts; 18 component sets; 57/43 public/in-house; skill-specific sub-mix construction then merge + decontaminate + downsample; synthetic fills capability gaps, not replaces corpus.

Four failure modes when packing hurts (missing block-diagonal mask, un-reset pos IDs, label mask not re-applied, using flash_attn_func instead of varlen); diagnostic procedure (100-step unpacked baseline, compare loss curves, differences > 0.01 nats = bug); speedup ~= L_max / avg(L_i).

SFT -> RM -> PPO three-stage pipeline; 13K prompts, 16 epochs, cosine, dropout 0.2; SFT is what RL starts from (pre-determines framing); beta * KL(pi || pi_SFT) term keeps RL tethered to the SFT manifold.

Llama-3 chat template tokens (<|begin_of_text|>, <|start_header_id|>role<|end_header_id|>, <|eot_id|>); iterative SFT/RS/DPO six rounds; SFT on response tokens only; tool use synthetic pipeline as a dedicated SFT stream.
Hybrid-thinking template with <|im_start|>role / <|im_end|>; thinking budget; long-CoT cold-start SFT + reasoning RL + non-thinking fusion; <think>...</think> scoped content inside assistant turns.

SFT + RL post-training on MoE 671B/37B-active; distillation of <think> reasoning from DeepSeek-R1; 5K H800 hours for post-training (small vs 2.664M pretrain); preserves both reasoning quality and output-length control.
R1 template: '<think>...</think><answer>...</answer>'; rule-based rewards require a template the parser can split; the template is SFT-frozen before RL starts.
